title: Fact
description: One displayed fact (spec 10.3): a value, its unit, the whitelisted source it came from, when it was retrieved, and its verification status. The app refuses to render a fact without a passing verification record.

unit.description: Unit symbol, e.g. "K", "g/mol", "kJ/mol". null when the value has no unit (counts, text, electron configurations).

uncertain.description: True for predicted or disputed values (e.g. superheavy elements). An uncertain value must be a range.

range.description: Closed interval. min <= max is enforced by the integrity tests, since JSON Schema can't compare fields.

sourceUrl.description: https URL on exactly one of the three whitelisted hosts (spec 5.1). The slash after the host blocks look-alikes such as pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov.example.com and user@host tricks.

retrieved.description: Date the value was retrieved from the source (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Only "pass" may appear in data/verified/. The other values exist for pipeline drafts.

recordId.description: ID of the per-fact record in verification/records/.
